summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727 KB sibling bundle
details: The package's preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) downloads the Bun runtime from the Bun GitHub release for the current platform, extracts it to a temp directory, and uses it to execute a shipped 727 KB sibling file `math_init.js` (Bun-CJS bundle, prefixed `// @bun @bun-cjs`) via `execFileSync(bunPath, [math_init.js], {stdio:'inherit'})`. Both `setup.mjs` and `math_init.js` are identifier-obfuscated: `setup.mjs` uses obfuscator.io-style renaming and string-lookup dictionaries (`_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`, `YCZJE`/`QkQej`), and `math_init.js` uses a shuffled constant-array decoder (`WV8StW`, `n7gIxM`) and `with` statements to hide its logic. The stated package purpose is an MCP server exposing ServiceTitan Anvil2 reference docs; the shipped obfuscated Bun bundle is not consistent with that purpose. Installing the package triggers the preinstall chain automatically, running the opaque bundle under a freshly-downloaded alternate runtime that bypasses Node-based inspection.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
